provenance.asset_description: Xareonshin, An imugi sits coiled, with a gat, a style of horsehair hat, resting atop its antlers and a Crucible Hellknight Boss, A furious Black woman with curly hair stalks forward, magic flames crackling in one hand and the other hand pointing at her unseen foes.
